name: Love Blossom Extended
source: "Who do you like more?" Your life turns upside down when your mother asks you that simple question. What will happen when love starts to bloom between you and your close friends? Who will you choose? Your childhood friend? His best friend? Or neither?
translation: “你更喜欢谁？”母亲一个简单的问题，就让你的生活天翻地覆。当爱情在你与亲密朋友之间萌芽，会发生什么？你会选择谁？青梅竹马？他的挚友？还是谁都不选？
